title: Extension by zero preserves integral constructibility and localizing categories
statement:
Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be a quasi-compact open immersion.

1. $j_!$ is exact, preserves all direct sums, preserves all limits, and
   commutes with reduction modulo $\pi_E^n$.
2. $j_!$ maps $\Dbc(U,\mathcal O_E)$ into $\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E)$.
3. $j_!$ maps $\Loc(\Dbc(U,\mathcal O_E))$ into $\Loc(\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E))$.

proof.text: Use the existing exactness instance for openImmersionLowerShriek and its mapDerivedCategory triangulated instance. The upstream derived open extension adjunction gives all small sums. Infer qcqs for both schemes from the separated finite-type structure maps.

Apply lem-sfb-condensed-open-extension-products. For a limiting cone c of M form the two products P and R and maps s,t. The induced k:c.pt to P is a kernel of s-t: a zero composite is precisely a compatible cone, and its factorization and uniqueness follow from c. Apply preservesKernel_of_pretriangulated. Additivity identifies F(s-t) with F(s)-F(t); the mapped kernel is an equalizer. buildIsLimit applied to the two preserved product fans and this equalizer proves the image cone limiting. This only preserves existing limits and does not assume equalizers exist for arbitrary pairs.
Apply integralOpenExtensionReduction to obtain the natural comparison for every n, including zero.

Use exactness to preserve the bounded interval and identify cohomology of extension with extension of cohomology. On qcqs U its constant-model constructibility supplies a Scheme.Stratification S. Forget only the constructibility field to obtain a finite locally closed stratification; keep the same domains, immersions, and models. The existing constant-model open-extension theorem gives constructibility of each extended cohomology module. Transport along the homology isomorphism using the same stratification and local covers.

Let P be Loc(Dbc(X)). Its preimage under the triangulated derived extension is triangulated and replete. The derived adjunction preserves coproducts of every universe size, and preservesColimitIso transports the coproduct closure of P to its preimage. The previous step sends the generators into P. Apply the intersection definition of localizingClosure and the generator inclusion supplied by localizingClosure_exists.
